description: This file implements a WebSocket-based media stream handler for bidirectional audio streaming between Twilio and AI transcription/TTS services. It manages WebSocket connections, stream sessions, TTS queues, and callbacks for transcription events.

classes.name: MediaStreamHandler
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections for Twilio media streams, handles start/stop/media events, manages TTS queues, and session lifecycle.

methods.name: handleUpgrade
methods.description: Handles WebSocket upgrade requests, initializes WebSocket server if needed, and manages connection limits.

methods.name: handleConnection
methods.description: Processes new WebSocket connections, handles message events, and manages stream sessions.

methods.name: handleStart
methods.description: Handles 'start' event, creates transcription session, and validates call and stream IDs.

methods.name: handleStop
methods.description: Handles 'stop' event, closes session, and clears TTS state.

methods.name: getStreamToken
methods.description: Extracts stream token from request URL.

methods.name: getClientIp
methods.description: Retrieves client IP address from request.

methods.name: registerPendingConnection
methods.description: Registers a pending WebSocket connection with IP throttling.

methods.name: clearPendingConnection
methods.description: Removes a pending connection and clears timeout.

methods.name: rejectUpgrade
methods.description: Rejects WebSocket upgrade with specified status code and message.

methods.name: getOpenSession
methods.description: Retrieves an active session with open WebSocket.

methods.name: sendToStream
methods.description: Sends a message to a stream's WebSocket if open, handles backpressure.

methods.name: sendAudio
methods.description: Sends mu-law encoded audio to a stream for TTS playback.

methods.name: sendMark
methods.description: Sends a mark event to track playback position.

methods.name: clearAudio
methods.description: Clears audio buffer to interrupt playback.

methods.name: queueTts
methods.description: Queues a TTS operation for sequential playback per stream.

methods.name: clearTtsQueue
methods.description: Clears TTS queue and interrupts current playback.

methods.name: getSessionByCallId
methods.description: Retrieves session by call ID.

methods.name: closeAll
methods.description: Closes all active sessions and clears resources.

methods.name: getTtsQueue
methods.description: Retrieves or creates TTS queue for a stream.

methods.name: processQueue
methods.description: Processes TTS queue sequentially, ensuring one playback at a time.

methods.name: clearTtsState
methods.description: Clears TTS state and aborts ongoing TTS playback for a stream.
